name: South Surrey Side Events 2019

venue.name: Church of the Holy Trinity
venue.details: Come in through entrance on Foster St

information: * Regular 3x3 will not be held at this competition. * If you are not competing in the blind events in the morning (3x3x3 Blindfolded and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind), you do not need to show up until after lunch. * All competitors will be expected to help out in order for the event to run smoothly. * Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals.
